_LABEL_METHODOLOGY: IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE INTERPRETING MODEL METRICS
label_source: Programmatically generated from HealthSense rule configuration (trainer.py)
label_description: Labels (RECOMMENDED=0, CAUTION=1, AVOID=2) were generated deterministically by applying configurable nutritional threshold rules to each (product, synthetic_member_scenario) pair. The ML model learns to generalize and interpolate these rule-based labels. This is NOT a model trained on clinically observed outcomes, dietitian-annotated data, or population health records.
_CLINICAL_VALIDATION: This model has NOT been clinically validated, dietitian-reviewed, or evaluated on real patient outcomes. It is an educational decision-support tool. Do not claim clinical validation.
_TFIDF_NOTE: The ingredient TF-IDF vocabulary is French-dominant due to multilingual Open Food Facts data. English-language ingredients may receive zero TF-IDF contribution. This is a known data quality issue documented for Phase 3 (multilingual retraining).

metrics._metrics_note: These metrics reflect performance on programmatically labeled test data only. They do not represent real-world clinical performance.

preprocessing.nutrition_scaler: StandardScaler — fitted on training nutrition columns only (16 features)
preprocessing.tfidf: TfidfVectorizer(max_features=25, ngram_range=(1,2)) — fitted on training ingredients only
preprocessing.split_strategy: Stratified split at barcode level (test_size=0.20, random_state=42). Zero product overlap between train/test confirmed.
preprocessing.nan_handling: NaN nutrition values replaced with 0.0 via np.nan_to_num() before scaling. Missingness is preserved via is_sugar_missing, is_sodium_missing, is_sat_fat_missing binary flags.

disclaimer: HealthSense AI provides educational food-health decision support only. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, clinical diagnosis, or dietitian consultation.
